title: Detective Comics #823 DC Nov 2006 Batman Poison Ivy Paul Dini Simone Bianchi
conditionDescription: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Detective Comics #823 (November 2006), DC Comics - Batman vs. Poison Ivy. Written by Paul Dini, art by Joe Benitez and Victor Llamas; cover by Simone Bianchi. Direct sales, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Kryptonite bike lock ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
